plugin-data.name: Basic security
plugin-data.description: Checks suspicious IPs attempting to connect to the admin area and configures IP blocking settings. Furthermore, securely modifies the core ADMIN_URI_FILTER constant and enables automatic recovery after core updates. Validates other security settings.

brute-force-attack-description: Brute force attack consists of an attacker trying many passwords or passphrases with the hope of eventually guessing correctly -Wiki. More details can be found on
minutes-blocked: Amount of minutes the IP is going to be blocked
number-failures-allowed: Number of failed attempts for the block to trigger
file-not-writable-warning: Warning: The core file is not writable. Please change permissions to 666 for:
core-rewrite-info-1: Enter the URI filter value you want to change and save it to customize the admin URL.
core-rewrite-info-2: The saved URL value will be updated the next time the admin panel is loaded.
core-rewrite-success-alert: The admin URL has been customized to "%s". Please use the new URL for your next access.
core-reset-auto-recovered-alert: Core file reset detected. The URL filter has been automatically re-applied to your previous custom setting: "%s". Please use this URL for your next access.
